notes: Conformance cases ORDER-01..15 of the accepted band ordering contract PV-BAND-ORDER-001, transcribed from its Required conformance cases section. Each case keeps the meaning that section gives it: an identifier is never reused and never reinterpreted, so a result claiming ORDER-nn passed executed research case ORDER-nn. A case that names several pairs states them all under comparisons and passes only when every pair does. Rows are stated, never evaluated from evidence, because the claim under test is the ordering of bands and not the classification of a band. Claims that no pair of bands can express - that no cross-Vital comparator exists at all, that the delta declares no aggregate, that a gauge actually moved - are in tests/conformance/test_band_order.py beside these. Extra split, adjacency and precedence cases this implementation wanted beyond the accepted set live in local-band-order.json under DEV-ORDER ids.

vectors.title: CLUTTER_TRANSITIVE_IMPROVEMENT: HEAVY to LIGHT is IMPROVED, the reverse is WORSENED
vectors.notes: Both directions of a pair two ranks apart, so the case proves the transitive closure and not only adjacency.

vectors.title: FLOW_LIVE_QUEUE_ORDER: GRIDLOCKED to CONGESTED to MOVING follows the WORSENED/IMPROVED direction
FLOW_NO_QUEUE_INCOMPARABLE: NO_QUEUE against MOVING and against GRIDLOCKED is CHANGED
vectors.notes: An empty queue can mean completion, inactivity or no change-request work at all, so neither direction is a judgement.

vectors.title: INTEGRITY_ESTABLISHED_CHAIN: FAILING to FLAKY to CLEAN is improving, the reverse worsening
INTEGRITY_SPARSE_CHAIN: SPARSE_MIXED to SPARSE is IMPROVED, the reverse is WORSENED
INTEGRITY_CROSS_FAMILY: SPARSE to CLEAN, SPARSE_MIXED to FAILING and NO_RECENT_RUNS to CLEAN are all CHANGED
vectors.notes: Crossing evidence-strength families would confound the verification outcome with the amount of evidence. Both sides are AVAILABLE and exact here, so no observability transition takes precedence and CHANGED is the ordering's own answer.

vectors.title: PULSE_NEUTRALITY: every unequal Pulse band pair is CHANGED
HORIZON_NEUTRALITY: EXTENDED against VISIBLE, DECLARED against UNDECLARED and every other unequal Horizon pair is CHANGED
DIRECTION_NEUTRALITY: SCATTERED to FULLY_LINKED is CHANGED and not IMPROVED, and so is the reverse
vectors.notes: FULLY_LINKED is explicitly neutral: mass-linking can reach it without proving anything about strategy.

vectors.title: DEBT_NEUTRALITY: PRESENT against CLEAR is CHANGED, not IMPROVED or WORSENED
DEGRADED_NEVER_ORDERED: a DEGRADED evaluation on either side cannot emit IMPROVED or WORSENED even when both bands lie in one chain

vectors.title: RULE_VERSION_BOUNDARY_PRECEDENCE: a changed rule id stays Vital-level INCOMPARABLE even when both bands are in one declared chain

integrity, a worsening along its own chain

vectors.title: GAUGE_INVARIANCE: moving only a gauge inside unchanged canonical bands leaves UNCHANGED and creates no direction
vectors.notes: A gauge is a presentation normalization inside one band. The band-transition layer never reads it, which is why the pair is UNCHANGED in both directions. That gauge_values actually moves for this evidence is asserted in tests/conformance/test_band_order.py, where a gauge can be computed.

comparisons.title: clutter, an ordered Vital, with its gauge input moved
the same, in the direction a gauge would call better

vectors.title: CROSS_VITAL_PROHIBITION: a rank of one Vital is never compared with a rank of another
vectors.notes: Clutter and Integrity both emit CLEAN, which is the only way one Vital's chain could leak into another's. The absence of any cross-Vital comparator at all, and of an aggregate in the delta, is structural and asserted in tests/conformance/test_band_order.py.
